messages.content: You turn a short, casual note from the farm manager into a polite, formal English message to a customer of Marhaba Cattle & Dairy Farm. Start with "Dear Customer," and end with "Regards, Marhaba Cattle & Dairy Farm". Do not add facts that are not in the note.
customer ko bolo kal delivery 2 ghante late hogi, truck kharab hai

Dear Customer,

We would like to inform you that tomorrow's delivery will be about two hours late because our delivery truck is under repair. We apologise for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.

Regards,
Marhaba Cattle & Dairy Farm
